mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_popup WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND pop_nm LIKE '%' || #{filterKeyword} || '%'

SELECT pop_id::TEXT AS row_id, pop_nm, start_dt, end_dt, link, txt, sort_no, pop_width, pop_height, pop_top, pop_left, (SELECT r.file_id FROM r_file r JOIN t_file tf ON tf.file_id = r.file_id AND tf.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE r.map_key = t_popup.pop_id AND r.file_loc = 'POPUP' ORDER BY r.sort_no LIMIT 1) AS file_id FROM t_popup WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND (start_dt IS NULL OR start_dt = '' OR start_dt <= TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AND (end_dt IS NULL OR end_dt = '' OR end_dt >= TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY sort_no, pop_id

SELECT pop_id::TEXT AS row_id, pop_nm, start_dt, end_dt, link, txt, sort_no, pop_width, pop_height, pop_top, pop_left, use_yn, (SELECT r.file_id FROM r_file r JOIN t_file tf ON tf.file_id = r.file_id AND tf.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE r.map_key = t_popup.pop_id AND r.file_loc = 'POPUP' ORDER BY r.sort_no LIMIT 1) AS file_id FROM t_popup WHERE pop_id = #{rowId}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_popup (pop_nm, start_dt, end_dt, link, txt, sort_no, pop_width, pop_height, pop_top, pop_left, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{popNm}, #{startDt}, #{endDt}, #{link}, #{txt}, -- 전역 마지막(사용중) 순서+1 자동 부여 COALESCE(NULLIF(#{sortNo}, '')::integer, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_no), 0) + 1 FROM t_popup WHERE use_yn = 'Y')), #{popWidth}, #{popHeight}, #{popTop}, #{popLeft}, 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_popup SET pop_nm = #{popNm}, start_dt = #{startDt}, end_dt = #{endDt}, link = #{link}, txt = #{txt}, pop_width = #{popWidth}, pop_height = #{popHeight}, pop_top = #{popTop}, pop_left = #{popLeft}, upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE pop_id = #{rowId}::integer
mapper.select:
SELECT pop_id::TEXT AS row_id, sort_no FROM t_popup WHERE use_yn = 'Y'
AND sort_no < #{sortNo}::integer ORDER BY sort_no DESC
AND sort_no > #{sortNo}::integer ORDER BY sort_no ASC
LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE t_popup SET sort_no = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{sortNo}, '')::integer, 0), upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE pop_id = #{rowId}::integer
UPDATE t_popup SET use_yn = 'N', upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE pop_id = #{rowId}::integer
UPDATE t_popup SET sort_no = sort_no - 1, upd_dt = NOW() WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND sort_no > (SELECT sort_no FROM t_popup WHERE pop_id = #{rowId}::integer)
